## 📖 Blog Post Tracking

This issue tracks the blog post that must be written for the resolution of:
- Resolved Issue: #
- Resolved in PR: #

## ✅ Checklist
- [ ] Root cause identified and documented
- [ ] Resolution steps written
- [ ] Prevention measures noted
- [ ] Blog file created: `docs/issue-blog/YYYY-MM-DD-<id>-<title>.md`
- [ ] Blog index updated
- [ ] PR opened for blog post
